mapper.select: select id, name, description, price, stock, category_name, image, status, sales from t_product
select id, name, description, price, stock, category_name, image, status, sales from t_product where name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
select id, name, description, price, stock, category_name, image, status, sales from t_product where category_name = #{categoryName}

select id, name, description, price, stock, category_name, image, status, sales from t_product where (name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) and category_name = #{categoryName}
mapper.insert: insert into t_product (name, description, price, stock, category_name, image, status, sales) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{categoryName}, #{image}, #{status}, #{sales})
mapper.update: update t_product set stock = stock - #{quantity}, sales = sales + #{quantity}, status = CASE WHEN stock - #{quantity} <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE status END where id = #{productId} and stock >= #{quantity}
update t_product set stock = stock + #{quantity}, sales = sales - #{quantity}, status = CASE WHEN stock + #{quantity} > 0 THEN 1 ELSE status END where id = #{productId}
